title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S06 E12 — The Tank
Grace's loyalties are tested as she and Frankie face the Sharks on "Shark Tank;" Robert scrambles to recoup the money he donated; Bud meets his long-lost cousin.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S06 E13 — The Change
Grace tries to make amends to Frankie; Sol gives Robert a taste of his own medicine; Brianna and Barry reach a turning point.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S07 E01 — The Roomies
With their exes living at the beach house and the FBI agents who arrested Nick sniffing around, Grace and Frankie frantically search for the money they hid.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S07 E02 — The Arraignment
While Frankie retrieves the cash, Grace and Nick discuss their marriage at his arraignment; Joan-Margaret hatches a plan for laundering the money.

title: Grace and Frankie
description:
S07 E03 — The Bunny
Bud tries to soothe discord at the beach house by throwing a brunch for the two families; revelations from the past create even more hard feelings.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S01 E04 — The Devil's Playground
Shade and Angie search for an arsonist and killer in the Toronto Islands; Shade's ego grows with his newly-minted P.I. license.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S01 E05 — The Six
A 14-year-old witness to a shooting must be protected; Shade tries to figure out who Angie spent the night with while trying to keep a promise to his daughter.

title: Private Eyes
description:
S01 E06 — Partners in Crime
Shade and Angie go undercover to try to expose a con artist; Angie, Jules and Don give Shade romantic advice.

title: Family Law
description:
S01 E03 — Addicted to Love
Abigail and Daniel defend Marlee, a mother whose addiction to online gaming has brought her parenting abilities into question; Daniel resolves to tie the knot with Danielle.

title: Family Law
description:
S01 E04 — Mama Don't Preach
Gay teenager Aaron wants to be emancipated from his parents because they are forcing him to attend a Pray Away the Gay camp.; initially skeptical of Aaron's reasons, the lawyers realize how serious the situation is.

description:

description:

description:

Nancy and Silas are approached with a new opportunity, Andy offers up love advice to Rabbi Dave and Doug tries to keep his fake charity from falling apart.

title: Weeds
description:

Nancy meets Rabbi Dave's friends during an awkward Shabbos dinner; Andy brings home a very special guest; Silas prepares for his new business venture; Shane and Angela attempt to retrieve some stolen property.

title: Weeds
description:
S08 E11 — God Willing and the Creek Don't Rise

description:

Nick has a chance to get out of jail, but Grace likes things the way they are; an old acquaintance helps Frankie with the money laundering.

description:

Grace and Frankie adjust to their new house mate; Robert and Sol join the neighborhood watch; Brianna reveals too much when meeting Barry's parents.

description:

The women try to help Nick reduce his sentence by implicating his partner; Sol attempts to catch a thief while Mallory establishes dominance at work.

description:

title: Family Law
description:
S01 E05 — Until Death Do Us Part
Abigail and Daniel represent Ira, who wants his wife Helen moved from a care home that he claims is worsening her Alzheimer's; because his daughter doesn't want Helen moved and holds power of attorney, Ira must challenge her in court.

description:

The lawyers are bewildered when a young couple begs them to reverse an adoption after learning about the baby's serious health issues; Abigail determines that the father is driving the decision, and convinces the mother to fight to keep the baby.

title: Weeds
description:

description:
